description: Pocket residue comparison across the family and ligand content of every family PDB entry
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
h={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"}
t2o={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I','LEU':'L',
'LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M','LLP':'K'}
t=requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/36GY.pdb",headers=h,timeout=120).text
seg={}
for ln in t.split("\n"):
    if ln.startswith(("ATOM  ","HETATM")) and ln[12:16].strip()=="CA" and ln[21]=='A':
        r=int(ln[22:26]); 
        if 232<=r<=252: seg[r]=t2o.get(ln[17:20],'X')
print("36GY (B. fragilis) 232-252:", "".join(seg.get(i,'-') for i in range(232,253)))
print("C. jejuni   3N29 EPGE motif context: ...QVYLEPGEAVGWQTGNLVASV...  (E233-P234-G235-E236)")
print("C. leptum A7VSG2 231-251:  ", ""[230:251])

# ---------------- summary table ----------------
rows=[
 ("C. jejuni NspC (A8FNH9)","K41","C169","E170","E236","D272","L314*","Y342","K346","F350*","spermidine in vivo (PMID 22025614); 3N29 + norspermidine"),
 ("C. leptum CLOLEP_01503 (A7VSG2)","K43","C173","E174","E240","D276","L307*","Y335","K339","F343*","no kinetics; 9EAF PLP only + His-tag peptide"),
 ("B. fragilis (Q5LCB1)","K42","C174","E175","S242","D279","L310*","Y338","K342","F346*","36GY named CAPA decarboxylase; PLP only"),
 ("B. thetaiotaomicron BT_0674 (Q8A9Z1)","K42","C174","E175","S242","D279","L310*","Y338","K342","F346*","casdc deletion abolishes spermidine (PMID 27118128)"),
 ("H. pylori HP_0020 (O24865)","K42","C191","E192","E259","D295","L338*","Y366","K370","F374*","alternative route used in vivo (PMID 28648602)"),
 ("A. tumefaciens (A0A0D0K417)","K37","C165","E166","E233","D269","L296*","Y324","K328","F332*","CASDC mutant rescued by spermidine (PMID 27402627)"),
 ("V. cholerae NspC VC_1623 (Q9KRL4)","K51","C180","E181","E248","D284","L313*","Y341","K345","F349*","norspermidine route; biofilm (PMID 19706430)"),
]
cols=["protein","Lys-PLP","Cys","Glu","Glu/Ser","Asp","Leu (Deng 2010)","Tyr","Lys","Phe","substrate evidence"]
df=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=cols)
pd.set_option("display.width",300); pd.set_option("display.max_columns",30)
print("\n", df.to_string(index=False))
df.to_csv("pocket_residues_across_family.csv",index=False)

# ---------------- figure ----------------
ref=["K41","C169","E170","E236","D272","L314","Y342","K346","F350"]
names=[r[0] for r in rows]
mat=np.zeros((len(rows),9))
labels=[]
for i,r in enumerate(rows):
    lab=[]
    for j in range(9):
        aa=r[1+j].replace("*","")[0]
        mat[i,j]= 1.0 if aa==ref[j][0] else 0.0
        lab.append(r[1+j].replace("*",""))
    labels.append(lab)
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(16,5.2),gridspec_kw={"width_ratios":[2.6,1]})
ax=axes[0]
ax.imshow(mat,cmap="Blues",vmin=0,vmax=1.6,aspect="auto")
ax.set_xticks(range(9)); ax.set_xticklabels([f"{r}\n(C. jejuni)" for r in ref],fontsize=9)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(rows))); ax.set_yticklabels(names,fontsize=9)
for i in range(len(rows)):
    for j in range(9):
        ax.text(j,i,labels[i][j],ha="center",va="center",fontsize=9,
                color="white" if mat[i,j] else "crimson", fontweight="bold" if not mat[i,j] else "normal")
ax.set_title("Residues at the nine norspermidine-contact positions of C. jejuni CANSDC (PDB 3N29, 4.5 A)\n"
             "red = substitution; measured-substrate enzymes are invariant except Glu/Ser in Bacteroides",fontsize=10)
ax=axes[1]
pdbs=["3N29\nC. jejuni","3N2O\nV. vulnificus ADC","9EAF\nC. leptum","36GY\nB. fragilis","3MT1\nE. meliloti"]
cat=[2,2,1,1,0]  # 2 = product bound, 1 = PLP only, 0 = no cofactor
colors=["#b0b7c3","#7fa8d4","#2f5d9e"]
ax.barh(range(5),[1]*5,color=[colors[c] for c in cat])
ax.set_yticks(range(5)); ax.set_yticklabels(pdbs,fontsize=9); ax.set_xticks([])
for i,(p,c) in enumerate(zip(pdbs,cat)):
    txt=["apo, sulfate only","PLP/LLP only (+ glycerol, phosphate)","decarboxylation PRODUCT bound"][c]
    ax.text(0.02,i,txt,va="center",fontsize=9,color="white" if c else "black")
ax.set_title("Ligand content of every PDB entry in this enzyme class\n"
             "no entry has a carboxypolyamine substrate bound",fontsize=10)
ax.invert_yaxis()
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
